summary: Venture Global, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 26, 2026, reporting that its indirect subsidiary, Venture Global Shipping Holdings, LLC, entered into a senior secured term loan facility for up to $1.5 billion, secured by nine LNG carriers. Proceeds will fund general corporate purposes, including reimbursement of venture Global LNG for vessel acquisition costs. The facility matures June 2032, bears Term SOFR plus 2.00%, and includes customary covenants. This is a routine financing agreement, not a special-situation corporate event.
